about_the_game:
Start a publishing company and become the biggest game publisher in the world! From the garage to a huge office, with a lot of employees. Make decisions about which games to invest in. Keep your employees happy and working, but keep an eye on your cash, as you are one bad game away from bankruptcy.

To make your employees happy, design the most efficient and comfortable office. You have a large selection of items to choose from, but beware, not all items are equally effective.

Create your own marketing division; it is one of the most important divisions in your company. Choose how you are going to promote the games. Are you going for ads, billboards and other traditional methods, or are you going for sponsored content and free demos?

  • Furnish your office with employees who can complain about the sound or environment around their desk.

  • Search for new game proposals; make matches you would like to play in genre and subject.

  • Content for a long playtime; in-game content for more than 40 in game years

  • Detailed info about expenses, income and profit to make educated decisions

  • Hire new employees, but beware of their skills.

  • Simulated interest and economy, demand will depend on popularity of genre and subject.

  • Organize playtests and help developers steer their game to success!

With this demo you will get to play for the first 7 years, with all the features of the full game.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2016
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 instructions, x86_64 CPU, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
